temporal_scope: Four exact March/June/September/December2022snapshots,not seasonal means,residual currents or annual extrema.
method: Finite paired component contours and unique linear strips between consecutive native transverse columns under the original fixed latitude or longitude. Native first-to-last minimum support retained where a boundary is censored.
selection_window_interpretation: Owner-specific0–30/100/200m windows select original cores;they do not cap connected layer depth or establish a bottom,uniform thickness or surface boundary. No surface gate is introduced.
minimum_span_interpretation: Minimum support is conditional on original contiguous piecewise-linear signed-component model definition,not a physical named-current thickness bound. Single-level zero is uninformative,not zero thickness or absent flow.
range_interpretation: Native-bracket conditional geometry scenarios,not physical uncertainty,confidence intervals,annual bounds or guaranteed true-boundary limits.
identity_scope: Coastal branches remain source-specific,not inherited offshore/parent depths or additive water volumes. Guiana permanence/alias ambiguity and Jutland gaps remain unresolved.
axis_anchor_interpretation: Original model axis proxies only;49unresolved cases retain null anchors and original candidate diagnoses. No replacement core,date,branch or source window.
interpretation: Partial regional signed-component geometry,not independently identified current body,flow-normal width,whole-route depth or physical water volume. No between-section interpolation or independent terrain clearance.
source_credit: HYCOM Consortium,NRL,COAPS-FSU; original source fields and qualifiers retained.
run_note: Inclusive component-thickness lower support under original contiguous piecewise-linear model definition; single-level zero is an uninformative bound, not absence.
